# loopyng

> Generate synthetic signals for ML pipelines


## Pages

- [loopyng](index.html.md): Generate synthetic signals for ML pipelines
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;loopyng&#96;   | Tools to create audio   |
- [loopyng](_autosummary/loopyng.html.md): Tools to create audio
- [loopyng.gen](_autosummary/loopyng.gen.html.md): Generate Audio
- [loopyng.gen.diagnosis_sounds](_autosummary/loopyng.gen.diagnosis_sounds.html.md): Tools for generating diagnostic audio signals.

- [loopyng.gen.voiced_time](_autosummary/loopyng.gen.voiced_time.html.md): Voice-based time announcement utilities.
- [loopyng.lite_sample_sounds](_autosummary/loopyng.lite_sample_sounds.html.md): Generate simple waveforms for audio synthesis and testing.
- [loopyng.sound](_autosummary/loopyng.sound.html.md): Sound utils
- [loopyng.sound.audio](_autosummary/loopyng.sound.audio.html.md): Audio processing and playback utilities.
- [loopyng.sound.audio_librosa](_autosummary/loopyng.sound.audio_librosa.html.md): Utils to view, hear, and manipulate audio.
- [loopyng.util](_autosummary/loopyng.util.html.md): A few general utils
- [loopyng.utils](_autosummary/loopyng.utils.html.md): General utils
- [loopyng.utils.date_ticks](_autosummary/loopyng.utils.date_ticks.html.md): Date tick formatting utilities for time-based plots.
- [loopyng.utils.infinite_waveform](_autosummary/loopyng.utils.infinite_waveform.html.md): Infinite waveform generation tools.
- [loopyng.utils.librosa_utils](_autosummary/loopyng.utils.librosa_utils.html.md): A few utils (specshow, melspectrogram) vendored from librosa.
- [loopyng.utils.plotting](_autosummary/loopyng.utils.plotting.html.md): Plot utilities for visualizing audio waveforms and spectrograms.
